newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight sees new inquiry.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight sees new inquiry.

text.p: New inquiry included Sugar Chartering Inc 19,000-19,500 bulk Rosario to US Gulf or Atlantic 1-10 August.

Sugar Chartering Inc also had about 12,000 Philippines to US Gulf or Atlantic 20-30 July. CSR had 20,000 bulk Queensland to Surabaya 20-30 July and Finagrain 14,000 bagged South Brazil to Red Sea or East Africa 20-25 July. Gill and Duffes had 14,000 bagged Rio de Janeiro to Yemen prompt.
Fixtures included CSR 25,000 bulk Queensland to New York early August and Simab 14,000 bagged Santos to Lagos prompt.
